pr_title: GameEngine: implement stateful Behavior Tree runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements the core runtime and authoring slices of ADR 0123 on the current main baseline, including the stateful runtime, typed decorators, bounded debugging snapshots, and lint-clean recursive evaluation helpers.

The Editor live graph overlay remains a follow-up slice and is not claimed by this PR.
